title: Untitled Adventure
setting: an old watchtower on a hill at dusk
intro: Write two or three sentences that set the scene and say what's at stake.

tool_missing.light: You have nothing to light it with.
tool_missing.unlock: You need a key for that.

gate.name: Gate
gate.desc: A broken gate in a low stone wall. A yard lies east.

yard.name: Yard
yard.desc: A weedy yard below the tower. A chest sits by the wall. The tower door is up a short stair; the gate is west.

tower.name: Tower Top
tower.desc: The top of the tower, open to the wind. A beacon of dry wood stands ready.

horse.name: horse
horse.desc: Your horse, saddled and restless. You could ride away now.

chest.name: chest
chest.desc: A wooden chest. Its lid is shut.

beacon.name: beacon
beacon.desc: A stack of dry wood, ready to light.

uses.fact: The key turns and the tower door swings open.
You strike sparks into the wood and the beacon roars up into the dusk.

interactions.fact: You swing into the saddle and ride.

beats.fact: Only a red line of light is left in the sky.

beacon.title: The Beacon
beacon.text: Write what happens when they succeed.

away.title: Riding Away
away.text: Write what happens when they leave.

dark.title: Darkness
dark.text: Write what happens when time runs out.

hints.hint: The chest in the yard might hold something.
The tower door needs the key.
Climb the tower and light the beacon.
